issue.title: Show loaded queue multipliers on TUI capacity surfaces
issue.description: A persisted queue_capacity_multiplier of 1.5 with no queue_capacity_explicit flag renders as c1.5x and as 1.5x budget (7.5 capacity units) on the TUI row, header, wait lane, queue ladder, clan digest, and roster digest, while the runner capacity record stays explicit-false.
